_doc: EXAMPLE unit FX bindings — the PLAN-fx-offload.md §2 declarative binding
format, shown for a line tank (ms_tanks_s2). Copy per unit to e.g.
client/units/<def>/bindings.json (or export the same table from Lua). The
binding interpreter (fx-offload X4, fx-bindings.ts) evaluates all bindings
for all visible entities each frame in SoA batches — no per-entity script.
`effect` / `sound` values are NAMES resolved through effects/library.json and
gamedata/sounds.lua. `when` is the tiny condition vocabulary (anim state,
health threshold, pieceRotating, velocity threshold) — NOT a language. Weapon
muzzle/impact/fire-sound normally come from effects/weapon-fx.json keyed by the
firing weapon; a per-unit `onEvent weapon_fired` binding here is only needed to
add unit-specific choreography (recoil anim, shell-eject) on top.

dustTrail._doc: reuses a light smoke style as a ground dust ribbon; swap for a dedicated dust_trail effect when authored

damageSmoke._doc: black-smoke plume from a damaged hull; intensity rises as health falls

gunFire._doc: unit-specific recoil layered on top of the weapon-fx.json muzzle; effect/sound here override the table for THIS unit if desired

onDeath._doc: death choreography = an effect-library burst chosen at event rate (fx-offload §3)
